method: Provider-free check and inspect through the ordinary local-run entry. Existing X11 sessions are reused; no model request or target execution is added for X12.

defaultDecision.basis: In the frozen initial panel, B and D both supported necessary semantics and valid coverage in 10/10 main units. D supplied no additional necessary or coverage benefit, had fewer first-response acceptances, more calls and more input/output tokens, and did not improve aggregate quality. B is therefore the ordinary default; D remains an explicit research option.

effect.revisionDiagnostic: 4/4 affected B/D units were full after the shared label-direction contract was clarified; this does not replace the initial panel or establish general reliability.
effect.regressionsRetained: Five trusted-header outputs remain partial for incomplete condition enumeration, and four initial outputs remain incorrect because their conclusion labels were reversed.

include: one declared repository and immutable source ref
declared principals, resources, relations, operations, conditions, policies and entries
per-obligation conclusions, cited facts, relation coverage and explicit missing facts
exclude: target execution, exploitation or deployment validation
automatic conversion of a whole source skill

unresolved: Initial-panel conclusion-label reliability remains 19/23 non-incorrect even though necessary semantics were supported in 23/23; the bounded revision only diagnoses the shared contract defect.
Trusted-header completeness remains partial, especially complete condition-outcome enumeration.
Only two target projects and five tasks were observed; N has no repeated units and cannot establish stability or a whole-platform causal effect.
Provider USD cost is unknown, and no human authoring-time or labor-savings measurement exists.
Source discovery, target execution and deployment facts remain outside the delivered boundary.
nextRoundMinimumImplementation: Add an opt-in top-level SkVM command that delegates to the existing strict check/run/inspect implementation with B as the default, the same explicit input and source boundary, and no evaluator or target tools. Validate that thin adapter on one new held-out repository/task before considering discovery or production-default use.
